scope_note: A practical, app-curated beginner sequence; not an official JLPT syllabus.

grammar_points.explanation_en: State that something is or belongs to a category, politely.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 以禮貌語氣表示某人或某物的身分或類別。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Mark the topic that the rest of the sentence describes.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 用「は」標示後文所描述的主題。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Turn a polite statement into a question.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 在禮貌句末加「か」構成疑問句。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Connect nouns for possession, affiliation, or description.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 連接名詞，表示所有、所屬或修飾關係。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Mark that the same statement also applies to another topic.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 表示同一敘述也適用於另一個主題。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Refer to things near the speaker, listener, or neither.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 指稱靠近說話者、聽話者或雙方都較遠的事物。

grammar_points.pattern: この・その・あの + N
grammar_points.explanation_en: Specify a nearby or distant noun.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 直接修飾名詞，指出遠近不同的特定事物。

grammar_points.formation: Place/topic + に + thing/person + が + あります/います
grammar_points.explanation_en: Express existence, using います for animate beings and あります otherwise.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 表示存在；有生命者用「います」，其他用「あります」。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Describe habitual or future actions politely.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 用禮貌形描述習慣或將來的動作。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Mark the direct object of an action.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 用「を」標示動作直接作用的對象。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Mark a specific time or destination.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 用「に」標示具體時間或目的地。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Mark where an action takes place.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 用「で」標示動作發生的場所。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Negate a present or future action politely.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 以禮貌形否定現在或將來的動作。

grammar_points.pattern: Vました・Vませんでした
grammar_points.formation: Verb polite stem + ました / ませんでした
grammar_points.explanation_en: Describe or negate a completed action politely.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 以禮貌形敘述或否定已完成的動作。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Describe nouns and polite predicates with i-adjectives.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 用い形容詞修飾名詞或構成禮貌述語。

grammar_points.formation: な-adjective + です / な + noun
grammar_points.explanation_en: Use na-adjectives as predicates or noun modifiers.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 用な形容詞作述語，或加「な」修飾名詞。

grammar_points.formation: Object of feeling + が + 好き/嫌い + です
grammar_points.explanation_en: Express likes and dislikes; the liked thing is marked by が.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 表達喜好；喜歡或討厭的對象用「が」標示。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Form the verb connector used by many beginner patterns.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 構成連接動作及多種初級句型所需的て形。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Make a polite request for an action.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 禮貌地請求對方做某個動作。

grammar_points.formation: Verb て-form + もいいです
grammar_points.explanation_en: Ask for or grant permission.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 詢問或給予做某事的許可。

grammar_points.formation: Verb て-form + はいけません
grammar_points.explanation_en: State that an action is prohibited.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 表示某個動作不被允許。

grammar_points.formation: Verb polite stem + たいです
grammar_points.explanation_en: Express what the speaker wants to do.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 表達說話者想做的事情。

grammar_points.formation: Verb polite stem + ましょう / ませんか
grammar_points.explanation_en: Suggest doing something together or invite someone politely.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 提議一起做某事，或禮貌地邀請對方。

grammar_points.explanation_en: Connect a reason to its result.
grammar_points.explanation_zh_hant: 用「から」連接原因與結果。
